plage_page.name: El Jadida Beach
plage_page.hero_subtitle: City Atlantic beach a short hop from the medina walls — sand, swell and easy town access.
plage_page.overview.title: Atlantic sand by town
plage_page.overview.p1: El Jadida’s city beach puts Atlantic water within easy reach of the Portuguese walls and the modern town. It is an urban shore — practical, busy in summer, and shaped by trade winds and swell.
plage_page.overview.p2: Conditions change with the ocean. Swimming is best when the sea is calm; always respect local flags and advice. For wider resort sand, continue to Sidi Bouzid.
plage_page.overview.p3: Use it for a simple swim-and-walk half day between heritage mornings and port evenings.

plage_page.faq.title: El Jadida Beach FAQ
plage_page.faq.q1.question: Safe for swimming?
plage_page.faq.q1.answer: When conditions are calm and flags allow. The Atlantic can be rough — check locally.
plage_page.faq.q2.question: Far from the cistern?
plage_page.faq.q2.answer: A short walk or taxi from the Portuguese City.
plage_page.faq.q3.question: Facilities?
plage_page.faq.q3.answer: Seasonal cafés and basic services along the front in summer.
plage_page.faq.q4.question: Quieter than Sidi Bouzid?
plage_page.faq.q4.answer: Different mood: more urban, closer to town amenities.
plage_page.faq.q5.question: Best season?
plage_page.faq.q5.answer: Summer for swimming; shoulder seasons for walks with fewer crowds.
